description: TI INA219 — I2C current/power monitor, ±26V common-mode range, 12-bit ADC, programmable gain (÷1 to ÷8). SOT-23-8 (DCN) package. Measures bus voltage (0-26V) and shunt voltage drop (±320mV max) for true power calculation. No calibration math needed — reports current in amps and power in watts directly.
name: ina219
watch_out_for: Shunt resistor NOT included — choose based on max expected current (e.g., 0.1Ω for 3.2A range). I2C address configurable via A0/A1 pins (16 possible addresses). Vbus measurement range 0-32V but 26V spec max. Input filter recommended for noisy environments. Calibration register must be set after power-up for accurate readings.
